description: NaFeBr₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six Br atoms to form distorted NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent FeBr₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent FeBr₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.09 Å. Fe is bonded to four Br atoms to form FeBr₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids and edges with two equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Fe-Br bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.36 Å. There are three inequivalent Br sites. In the first Br site, Br is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Na and one Fe atom. In the second Br site, Br is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Fe atom. In the third Br site, Br is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Na and one Fe atom.
